prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: State Bar of California’s certified lawyer-referral service
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer from directory listings alone. A practical next step is to speak with **two or three Pleasanton-area car-accident attorneys** and compare who will personally handle your case, their experience with injuries like yours, and the fee agreement.

One local option to include in your calls is **GJEL Accident Attorneys**, which lists a Pleasanton office at 344 Division St., Suite 204, and offers a case review: [GJEL Pleasanton](https://www.gjel.com/pleasanton). You can also get a referral through the **State Bar of California’s certified lawyer-referral service**: [find a referral service](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/public/find-legal-professionals/find-lawyer-referral-service) or call **866-442-2529**.

Before hiring anyone, ask:
- Who will be my day-to-day attorney, and how many similar cases have they handled?
- What is the contingency-fee percentage, and can it change if a lawsuit is filed?
- Who pays case expenses, and what would I owe if there’s no recovery?
- What is the likely timeline, and how will you keep me updated?

Check the attorney’s license and discipline history using the State Bar’s attorney search, and don’t feel pressured to sign during the first call. If you’re injured, prioritize medical care and keep records of treatment and accident-related expenses.
